text:
anya: quick sync 1: proposing a "fast-header gate" for ingress: tiny, deterministic header that the router parses to decide routing, retention, and sampling. Keep body opaque (body_ref). Goal: avoid duplicated heavy parsing and cap tag cardinality. thoughts? :thinking:
mike: love the idea. two must-haves: 1) billing determinism (no fuzzy resolution), 2) stitchable traces if enrichment is async.
sai: +1. propose fields in header: trace_id, billing_token (opaque), retention_hint, sample_hint, body_ref, checksum, schema_v. router only decodes those.
rebecca: sketch of header I mocked: ```json
{"hdr_v":"1","trace_id":"t_abc","billing_token":"btok_123","retention":"standard","sample_hint":true,"body_ref":"s3://obs/2026/part-1.avro","checksum":"sha256:...","schema_v":"v2"}
```
anya: operational rules: if billing_token present -> resolve synchronously to billing_key via small cache and force full materialization; if resolve misses -> quarantine and retry (can't bill unresolved). If billing_token absent -> honor sample_hint and route to sampled/cheap lane.
mike: tracing: sidecars must inject trace_id when clients omit it. Enrichers and materializers must preserve trace_id and include materialization_manifest (materializer_id + time + checksum). Stitcher uses trace_id + checksum to join.
sai: retention: use retention_hint enum (short|standard|long). storage router enforces TTL per-envelope. This preserves existing lane-based contracts without separate lanes.
rebecca: dedupe/backfill: materializers idempotent using body_ref + checksum + schema_v. They write a manifest; late materializations should not mutate past billing records. Instead emit a bill_update snapshot for reconciliation.
anya: perf question: header-only decode budget p50 < 1ms. Infra run a decode bench across a representative sample. If it fails, we fallback to two-lane approach. @infra-bot
infra-bot: perf job queued: ci/obs/fast-header-decode-5112345678. ETA 12h. Link: https://ci.redwood/obs/bench/5112345678
mike: migration plan: 1) accept fast-header envelopes in parallel with current lanes, 2) route 5% non-billing traffic via gate, 3) validate billing p95/latency + join-index correctness, 4) expand and flip billing tenants last. rollback toggle per-cohort.
sai: query compat: maintain a compact join-index (body_ref -> enriched_attrs manifest). Queries can join at runtime or use pre-materialized views. Index TTL follows retention_hint. Keep index small to avoid cardinality blowup.
rebecca: metrics to watch: billing_resolution_failures, billing_latency_p50/p95, parser_cpu_ms_p50, attr_cardinality_growth, join-index-hit-rate, materializer-error-rate. burn thresholds should be defined for top billing tenants.
anya: action items: I'll draft the RFC with header schema + migration checklist + manifest spec. Mike will validate SLO deltas. Sai will design join-index. Infra will post perf numbers. Tagging for Wednesday sync. :white_check_mark:
